description: Ministry of Sports - Oder made to direct the Director General of the Department of Sports Development to convene and conduct a meeting of Sri Lanka Auto Mobile Sports Association to elect new offce bearers
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a legal direction issued under the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973 and its associated regulations. It involves regulatory authority and compliance requirements for a national sports association, specifically directing the convening of a meeting to elect new office bearers. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes, as the ministerial signature is part of the regulatory action rather than being the primary focus of the content.
